result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found 2 minor layout issues related to horizontal content truncation.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third item 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right edge, showing truncated text without clear indication it scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible cards clearly indicate horizontal scrollability, or add ellipsis and proper spacing so truncated names are handled gracefully.

issues.description: The category filter row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') appears cut off at the right edge with a partial next item, which may not be obvious as scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual affordance (fade edge or partial chip) to indicate more categories are available by scrolling.
